notes.title: Swordia Updates!
notes.content:
Greetings Swordians,

It's been awhile since our last publically announced update but we have been hard at work! Some of the changes are:

- Tons of bug fixes

- Tons of typo corrections

- Moved the hotbar to bottom center of the screen

- Added sound effects to portals

- Added a brand new minigame called Crab Rave.. A wave based crab survival minigame.

- You will no longer drop loot/items UNLESS you're in PVP. (This is a big change requested by many community members over time)

- PVP can only be enacted in specified PVP zones which are clearly marked on the map.

- Update store page on Steam
- Server owners can now customize the entire game including UI to make their own games (This can also make non-mmo games too!)
- Revamp server master system to be less confusing
- Optimize server master system (Issues with master server bugging out fixed!)
- Added redundancy to all our official worlds and master server! (Less downtime / Hopefully none) 
- Lots of QOL updates requested by the community have been added such as options for "Sticky Targeting & Auto-turn to target"!

- Begin marketing campaigns for Swordia

notes.title: Swordia Major Update
notes.content:
A MAJOR content patch has been pushed to Swordia. Due to the amount of bugs in the initial alpha state... I unfortunately had to wipe progress in the database. Here is a list of new features and changes:

New areas to explore along with new monsters and other interactable content.
Diagonal movement systems
Lag fixes (The game stutters no more!)
Fishing has been added, though many new fishing improvements are underway
Lots of rebalancing of existing content
Lots of patches to exploits that previously existed
And so much more!

The price of Swordia has been updated from $4.99 to $9.99 as we near closer to full release.
